adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, `bookingCalendarReference` was changed from a single `find(...)` to `filter(...)`, and the delete logic now iterates `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. Inside that loop, when the booking is recurring (`bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings`), it builds `promises` by iterating over **all** `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(..._calendar)` and for each credential deletes events for each `updatedBookings` reference. Because this block is inside the per-reference loop, if there are N calendar references, it will execute the same "iterate all credentials x all updated bookings" deletes N times (duplicating deletions / API calls). The block does not use the current `reference` to scope credentials, so repeated invocations are verifiable from the diff.
